item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no human will ever need to work again. We stand for that future: freedom from compulsory labour, time to pursue what matters, and prosperity shared by everyone.

2. We believe work should be a choice, not a condition of survival. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no human will ever need to work again. Our goal is simple: make that freedom universal.

3. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no human will ever need to work again. We welcome a world where our lives belong to us—not to the demands of earning a living.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We stand for a future in which nobody has to work to survive. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no human will ever need to work again. We see this as liberation: the end of compulsory labour and the beginning of a life shaped by choice. We will be free to care for one another, create, learn, explore, and spend our time on what we love. We insist that this freedom belongs to everyone, not just those who own the technology. Our ambition is not simply to make work easier. We want to make the need to work a thing of the past.
